design.summary: Designed the change to add an optional limit parameter to Table.search() with proper query caching integration.

implementation.summary: Implemented the optional limit parameter in Table.search(cond, limit=None) supporting query cache slicing, ascending document ID order, and full backwards compatibility when limit=None or when limit exceeds the number of matching documents.
